# astr3

> MIT TypeScript library for explorable Western astrology wheels with Three.js.
> Browser rendering, headless models, optional local ephemeris, natal and transit charts.
> Version 0.1.0 is experimental. The repository builds an installable tarball; npm publication is pending.

## Integration

- [Getting started](README.md): local demo, tarball installation, natal and transit examples.
- [Agent integration](docs/agent-integration.md): entry-point selection, headless example, browser lifecycle and common mistakes.
- [API contracts](docs/api.md): input, aspects, options, events, picking and accessibility.
- [Transit API](docs/transits.md): composite models, source-qualified selections and transit updates.
- [Calculation conventions](docs/calculations.md): coordinate conventions, houses, nodes and measured accuracy limits.
- [Architecture](docs/architecture.md): model, provider, renderer and application boundaries.

## Contributing

- [Repository agent instructions](AGENTS.md): source map, invariants, checks and local commits.
- [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md): reproducible setup and review workflow.
- [Release checklist](docs/releasing.md): history, privacy, builds and packed artifacts.
- [Security reporting](SECURITY.md): private reporting policy and data handling.
- [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md): current capabilities and upcoming changes.
